summary: Recent updates to the Web Speech feature in Firefox have focused on improving its reliability by blocking the self-start of the speech recognition service when the audio session is interrupted. This change is significant because it enhances the overall user experience by preventing unintended interruptions or errors in voice commands, ensuring that spoken inputs are processed only when the audio environment is stable. **Improved accuracy in dictation and voice commands can lead to better user satisfaction and efficiency, especially in noisy conditions.**
